svg.text: Everything on this page happened, or was first reported, on Wednesday 18 November 2026.
Xi welcomes Trump on the tarmac in Shenzhen
Air Force One landed at Shenzhen Baoan. Xi Jinping greeted Trump on the
tarmac. A state banquet followed with Putin between the two leaders.
Bahrain and Kuwait intercept Iran drone salvo
Iran launched Shahed drones and Fateh missiles at US radar sites. Both
countries said interceptors stopped the bulk of the attack.
Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth
JPL confirmed Voyager 1 crossed 25.9 billion km from Earth at 03:14 UTC. The
1977 probe still returns plasma and cosmic-ray data.
